Name: A Cuter and Less Square Vincent
Author: dogwatt
Description:
[font=Verdana][color=#ea9999]I wanted a version of Vincent that had a cuter and more rounded look, but still stayed loyal to the art style and character design of Stardew Valley... so I made it! [url=https://www.jemoticons.com/][color=#ea9999][size=4]（´・｀ ）♡[/size][/color][/url]

This mod adds cuter portraits and character sprites of Vincent.  This mod is great for people who are looking for a Vincent that is cute as heck but doesn't break the game's art style.  Enjoy ~[/color]

[/font]
